findings.detail: The 1,153,606 cost belongs to the D&D Buyer revolver row, whose source fair value is 1,130,534; the adjacent D&D Buyer term loan is a separate position with fair value 31,654,959.

rationale: X07 fired because the extracted row pairs cost 1,153,606 with a fair value more than 10x cost. In the raw schedule, table 23 row 27 shows that cost 1,153,606 is the D&D Buyer, LLC revolver and its fair value is 1,130,534, not an extreme appreciation. The next row is a separate D&D Buyer term loan, so the flag reflects a real extraction/row-alignment defect rather than a valid outlier.
